import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    s=np.sin(p[5]*t)
    c=np.cos(p[5]*t)
    return p[0]+p[1]*t+p[2]*P+p[3]*P*np.log(P)+p[4]*P*s+p[6]*s+p[7]*c+p[8]*P*c+p[9]*t*P
